title: Car Plows Through RV in Kroger Parking Lot Crash in Murfreesboro, Tennessee - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago A car collided with an RV in a Kroger parking lot in Murfreesboro, Tennessee, resulting in a three-vehicle pileup with all occupants sustaining only minor injuries. Parking lots have a sneaky reputation for being more dangerous than the open road, and a Sunday evening incident in Murfreesboro, Tennessee, just added another chapter to that argument. What started as a quiet grocery run at a neighborhood Kroger turned into a scene straight out of an action movie when a car collided with an RV with enough force to nearly punch all the way through it.
